name: harristeeter-mcp
description: Harris Teeter grocery pickup for Claude — search products, build the cart, pick a pickup time and start checkout

tools.name: ht_search_products
tools.description: Search Harris Teeter groceries at your pickup store, with prices and stock

tools.name: ht_get_products
tools.description: Look up products by UPC: price, sale price, size and pickup stock

tools.name: ht_get_cart
tools.description: Show the cart with names, prices and an estimated subtotal

tools.name: ht_add_to_cart
tools.description: Add groceries to the cart by UPC

tools.name: ht_update_cart_item
tools.description: Set an item's quantity or substitution preference

tools.name: ht_get_store
tools.description: Show the pickup store this account shops at

tools.name: ht_list_timeslots
tools.description: List available pickup windows and fees for the cart

tools.name: ht_start_checkout
tools.description: Reserve a pickup window and create the checkout (you place the order on harristeeter.com)

tools.name: ht_get_checkout
tools.description: Show the checkout draft: items, window, fees, tax, total and the place-order link

harristeeter_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (advanced)
harristeeter_ws_port.description: Override the fetchproxy concentrator port (default 37149). The whole fetchproxy fleet shares 37149 and the ContextMint Bridge extension dials that one port, so change this only if you know why.

harristeeter_debug.title: Debug logging
harristeeter_debug.description: Set to 1 for verbose bridge logging to stderr.

mcp_user_tz.title: Time zone
mcp_user_tz.description: IANA time zone sent with pickup-time requests (default America/New_York).
